shortDescription: Three z-levels (sky/surface/basement) in ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling/needs/work/storage come free from vanilla. Per-band biomes resolve through vanilla's per-cell BiomeAt API; sky plateaus grow real vegetation, basements can be carved as Biomes! Caverns caves, and the camera can pan freely with other levels hidden behind a black curtain.
body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED** (156 files / 40,713 LOC). Current tree: **52 files / ~10,100 LOC**.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`, so the column behaves as one big map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE

One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`. Bands stack along **+z**, each a contiguous `CellIndices` range. `band = surfaceBand + level`; bottom-to-top = basement / surface / sky. An impassable, permanently-fogged **gutter** separates bands. Live layout: `200×768`, bandCount 3, bandHeight 200, slot 256, gutter 56, surfaceBand 1.

**`Slot` is rounded up to a multiple of 64** — terrain shaders sample from WORLD POSITION, so a non-aligned offset renders identical terrain at a different texture phase in the see-below view.

### The one insight everything rests on
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Two distant regions sharing a `RegionLink` are adjacent as far as RimWorld is concerned. Both ends are `RegionType.Portal` (the stair subclasses `Building_Door`), and `Portal` fails `ShouldBeInTheSameRoom`, so the link **conducts connectivity without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum**. `Reachability.CanReach` is managed region-BFS, so it works unpatched — transitively fixing `ClosestThingReachable`, `RegionTraverser`, storage search and **every `WorkGiver_Scanner`**.

**Verified in play:** cross-band `HaulToContainer`, `HaulToCell`, `Ingest`, `Clean`, `BuildRoof`, `FinishFrame`, `LayDown`, `SocialRelax` — no hauling code written.

### ⚠ Portal regions are ONE CELL
`IsOneCellRegion(Portal)` is **true**: every door cell is its own Portal region. A 2×2 stairwell is **4 Portal regions per end**; a wormhole must link **every cell pair**. `AB2: band info` prints `links armed = N/M cells` with a `<-- PARTIAL` warning. `AllowsMultipleRegionsPerDistrict(Portal)` is **false**; the 3×3 grand staircase (9 Portal regions) is beyond anything vanilla ships.

### The dividing line
| Class | Outcome |
|---|---|
| **Graph / logic** — reachability, storage, work scanning, hauling, needs, reservations | **FREE** |
| **Geometry / presentation** — LOS, range, targeting, path lines, ghosts, projectiles, labels, selection | **NOT free** |

Fix each geometry surface **at its own draw/compute site**. Never patch `Thing.DrawPos` globally — the see-below renderer translates emitted vertices, so a pre-localized DrawPos double-shifts (V1's `DrawPosOffsetPatcher`).

### Reachability-as-proxy
Some vanilla code uses `CanReach` to mean *"is this a sensible place"*. Confirmed in `WanderUtility.GetColonyWanderRoot` — idle pawns commuted across bands to stand somewhere. Fixed by clamping to the pawn's band. **Un-audited:** joy/recreation spots, meditation focus, animal grazing/pen logic.

### Hard 1.6 constraints
- Pathfinder is **jobified**; A* neighbour expansion is **not patchable**. Custom traversal lives at `Pawn_PathFollower`.
- `PathFinder` has **no `FindPath`** — managed surface is `FindPathNow` + `PathFinderTick`.
- `PathUtility.BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on **unwalkable** cells and does **not** special-case doors.

### ⚠ Map components are UNSET during generation
`ABBandMap.Setup` runs in the `GenerateMap` postfix, so throughout generation `bands.Banded` is **false**. Genstep-time band math must use `ABBandedGeneration.TryPendingSurfaceRect`.

---

# 2. PER-BAND BIOME — SOLVED, VERIFIED IN PLAY

V1 got per-level biomes free (`pocketTileInfo.PrimaryBiome`). V2 has one `Map` and `Map.Biome` is get-only.

**The discovery:** 1.6 ships a **per-cell biome API** — `map.BiomeAt(cell)` → `MixedBiomeMapComponent.GetBiomeAt(cell)`. Vanilla routes its own systems through it: `WildPlantSpawner` (9 sites — plant CHOICE, density, regrow days, cave-plant commonality), `WildAnimalSpawner` (5), `MapGenUtility` terrain (10). `Patch_MixedBiome_ABBandBiomeAt` prefixes that one choke point and answers from `ABBandEnv.BiomeOf`.

**Not the rejected pattern:** what was ruled out was a contextual `map.Biome` *getter* on an ambient latch. `GetBiomeAt` takes the cell as a **parameter** — no ambient state, no ordering hazard.

**Scope guard:** only claims non-zero levels, so the surface keeps Odyssey's mixed-biome grid.

**A patch was DELETED:** `Patch_WildPlantSpawner_ABBandDensity` would now (1) **double-count** — `GetBaseDesiredPlantsCountAt` is *fertility only*; vanilla applies density separately in `CalculateDesiredPlants` — and (2) its **basement hard-zero** blocked cavern regrowth.

---

# 3. SKY VEGETATION
`ABSkyBandGen` **spawned zero plants** (terrain only) — summits generated bare. Added `SeedFlora`. Also `AB_OpenSky`'s `wildPlants` list was **dead code** (`skyBiomeInherit=true` meant `BiomeOf` never read it).

**Sky biome is LOCKED to the surface biome** (user decision). No species filter — vanilla's per-cell `fertilityMin` gate keeps lowland/water species off plateau soil. Setting: `skyVegetationDensity` (0–2×).

---

# 4. BIOMES! CAVERNS BASEMENTS
`BiomesCavernsCompat` ported **verbatim**. `ABCavernGen` ports V1's carve genstep. **Three V2 changes:** band-scoped rects (V1 carved `CellRect.WholeMap`); scribed `ABBandMap.basementBiome` (no per-band `PrimaryBiome`); and `RunForeignGenStep` snapshots `listerThings`, runs BC's map-wide scatterer, then destroys strays outside the band. Earthen Depths at 40/30/30 pending play test.

---

# 5. VANISHING COLONISTS — FIXED, VERIFIED ("colonists always spawn")
`ScenPart_PlayerPawnsArriveMethod` spawns the colony from **`GenerateIntoMap`** via the `ScenParts` GenStep — *during* generation (order: `FindPlayerStartSpot` 40 → `ScenParts` 41 → `Fog` 48). The old fix ran in the `GenerateMap` postfix on a comment asserting pawns spawn after generation — false. So colonists dropped wherever vanilla picked, then `Carve` ran `Destroy(DestroyMode.Vanish)` over them.

**Fix:** `Patch_GenStep_FindPlayerStartSpot_ABSurfaceBand` clamps the spot into the surface band before anything consumes it (24-cell margin, since `DropCellFinder` scatters pods). Plus `RescueStrandedColonists`, which **moves** rather than destroys any player pawn outside the surface band.

---

# 6. CAMERA

### Bug: colonies opened on the wrong level — FIXED
The viewed band lived in a **static `Dictionary<int,int>` keyed by `map.uniqueID`, never cleared**. `uniqueID` restarts at 0 each new game, so every colony inherited the previous one's band. Moved to **`ABBandMap.viewBand`** (per-map, not scribed); `FinalizeInit` forces the surface band **and explicitly moves the camera** — load-bearing, because with free panning there is no clamp to pull a restored camera back.

### Free panning — two halves, and only having one caused the "red errors"
1. **Hiding (`Patch_CameraDriver_ABClipViewToBand`).** Both halves of "what is on screen" derive from `CameraDriver.CurrentViewRect`: `MapDrawer.ViewRect` is `CurrentViewRect.ExpandedBy(1)…` (so `DrawMapMesh` skips non-overlapping sections) and `DynamicDrawManager.ComputeCulledThings` builds its Burst cull job from it. One postfix hides terrain AND pawns. Chosen over patching either draw site because `ThingCullDetails` is a **private nested struct**. Only the returned value is modified, so vanilla's `lastViewRect` cache is intact. Memoized per frame on `Time.frameCount` (resolving bounds costs **two CWT probes**), invalidated on `SetBand`/`JumpTo`, and **gated behind `freeCameraPan`**.

2. **`ABBandCurtain` — the missing half.** **RimWorld's map camera does not clear to a background colour**; it relies on the map mesh covering the screen. Clipping sections away means those pixels are *never written*, so they show undefined GPU memory — observed as a full-screen **red field with a blue rectangle**. Two opaque black quads (below and above the band, extending 2000 cells past the map) guarantee every off-band pixel is defined and black. Two `Graphic.DrawMesh` calls/frame, unconditional on banded maps.

**This is why the symptom lied.** It looked like a texture/shader fault and was neither: `AB2: shader report` came back clean on every shader and material this mod draws with, because nothing was drawing *wrongly* — nothing was drawing *at all*.

---

# 7. MEASURED PERFORMANCE

| Stage | Total mod cost / 2000 frames |
|---|---|
| Baseline | **3,791 ms** (58 patches) |
| Overlay + re-arm gate + V1 delete | **740.9 ms** (22 patches) |
| Event re-arm + lighting bake | **122.4 ms** |
| Same build, 17 colonists | **215.8 ms** — fps 59.2, f95 16.69 ms |

1. `OverlayDrawer.DrawAllOverlays`: **1.406 → 0.0018 ms/frame**.
2. Wormhole re-arm: **0.339 ms/frame → 0, and no longer a patch.** Gating a hot method with a prefix recovered only 22% because the gate *added a second patch to a very hot method*. Now event-driven.
3. `SectionLayer_LightingOverlay` bake: **25 → 0.** Suppressing `Visible` stops the DRAW but not the BAKE.
4. **V1 deleted** — never inert, only idle.

Measured **not** a problem: `SectionLayer_ABBelowV2.Regenerate` ≈ **0.9 µs/call**.

**⚠ Unmeasured:** `GetBiomeAt` (per-cell in `WildPlantSpawner` loops; memoized), `CurrentViewRect` (memoized), `ABBandCurtain` (2 draw calls).

### Pathfinding
| Scenario | Banded | Vanilla | Ratio |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ai.pathfind` | **556.6 µs** | 944.6 µs | **0.59×** |
| `ai.reachability` | 1.152 µs | 0.393 µs | 2.9× |
| `world.regions` | 0.339 µs | 0.071 µs | 4.8× |

**No per-path regression.** The tax is reachability and region lookup, ~3× the regions/cells.

---

# 8. LESSONS

1. **Classify by BEHAVIOUR, not directory.** `Section` instantiates every `SectionLayer` reflectively — deleting one is invisible to the compiler; **a green build proves nothing**.
2. **A benchmark that surprises you is usually broken.** Sample outside the stopwatch; divide by effective iterations.
3. **Nested instrumentation inflates outer timings.**
4. **`PawnRenderer.GetBodyPos` discards `drawLoc`** for a humanlike in a bed.
5. **`RenderPawnAt` only self-heals when `!results.valid`.**
6. **A malformed `About.xml` silently DROPS a mod.**
7. **Never mutate a collection you're enumerating from a callback.**
8. **Diagnostics that omit the discriminating field cost cycles** — and a verdict that contradicts its own data is worse than none. The stuck watchdog printed `BLOCKED — movement is obstructed` while reporting `walkable=True occupant=none edifice=-`, because it inspects `nextCell` AFTER `ResetToCurrentPosition()` has set it to the pawn's own cell. Still unfixed.
9. **Look for a vanilla API before building a workaround.** The per-band biome regression stood as "V2's one genuine loss" while `map.BiomeAt(cell)` existed all along. Found by grepping the **consumer** (`WildPlantSpawner`), not the concept (`Map.Biome`). Same lesson twice: clipping `CurrentViewRect` beat patching two draw sites.
10. **Distrust confident comments about ordering.** The vanishing-colonist bug survived because a comment claimed pawns spawn after generation. **Verify ordering claims against the genstep list.**
11. **Static collections keyed by a game-scoped id leak across games.** `map.uniqueID` restarts at 0. Per-map state belongs on the map component.
12. **"Nothing drawn" ≠ "black".** RimWorld's map camera has no clear colour, so any region you stop drawing shows undefined framebuffer content — flat blocks of arbitrary colour that *look* like a texture or shader bug. **If you suppress drawing, you must draw something opaque instead.** A clean shader report is the tell.
13. **Unity's own errors bypass the in-game bridge.** `Debug.LogError` (shader/mesh/material) never reaches Verse's `Log`, so the error monitor stays silent and only Player.log has it — and an *unsupported* shader is swapped silently with no log line at all.
14. Misc: `menuHidden` doesn't exist on ThingDef · geysers are `destroyable=false` · `GenStep_Fog` fogs the whole map · `GenRadial` caps at ~79.8 · `MapDrawLayer.map` is private · emit ONE self-contained log message per event.

**PROCESS: measure, don't reason.**

---

# 9. DIAGNOSTICS
`AB2: band info` · `AB2: transit health` · `AB2: below pawn report` · `AB2: why is this pawn stuck` · **`ABStuckWatchdog`** · `AB2: toggle transit logging` · `AB2: below layer report` · `AB2: lighting report` · bisect toggles · `AB2: spike - build wormhole chamber` · **`AB2: biome report`** (round-trips real `map.BiomeAt()` vs `BiomeOf()`, prints `<-- MISMATCH` if they disagree) · **`AB2: shader report`** (every shader/material this mod draws with + `isSupported`; flags `Hidden/InternalErrorShader`).

---

# 10. OPEN WORK

### Verified in play
Biomes · colonist spawning ("colonists always spawn").

### Untested
Black curtain · camera load-onto-ground-floor · cavern basements (**surface-band stalagmite leak** is the key check) · Earthen Depths temperature.

### Bugs
- **Stairwell stall — root cause AGREED with user.** Pawns stall when the approach is blocked or only diagonal (stairs placed flush against walls). **The stairs themselves are exonerated:** `Building_ABStairs2` overrides `FreePassage => true` and `PawnCanOpen => true`, and `Building_Door.BlocksPawn` is `openInt ? false : !PawnCanOpen(p)` — so it returns false unconditionally and a pawn can never be blocked *by* a link. The blocker is surrounding geometry, compounded by `PathUtility.BlocksDiagonalMovement` not special-casing doors. `nextCell == pawn.Position` is the `ResetToCurrentPosition()` signature of the retry loop. **Agreed fix (not yet built): a PlaceWorker requiring ≥1 clear cardinal approach.** Footprints already buy approaches (4/8/12), not speed.
- **COMBAT — status was STALE in the old handoff.** Not untouched: **575 LOC / 3 files** implement shootline, body facing, gun-sprite aim, `ShotReport` distance localization, cross-band acquisition, projectile-origin translation. Correct status: **implemented, never verified in play.** (a) projectiles below still never drawn (`ABBelowDynamicDraw` iterates pawns only) — CONFIRMED; (b) "will still miss" likely obsolete since the origin patch moves the projectile into the target's band. **Untested:** downward shots need below-draw to be visible; **upward shots draw in the band above and the see-below renderer only looks down** — invisible even after fixing (a).

### Deferred
Elevator (needs TWO counterparts on one building; `AB_Elevator.png` exists, unreferenced) · Transplant (fixes the coastline caveat — **inland tiles for now** — plus save migration) · turret cross-band targeting · drafted move ghost · Alpha Biomes carve types (installed).

### Perf backlog
Profile `GetBiomeAt` + `CurrentViewRect` + curtain · map gen ~3× slower · isolate `PathGridJob` rebuild · compat audit not started.

---

# 11. VERTICAL LINKS

| Def | Footprint | Cardinal approaches |
|---|---|---|
| `AB2_LadderDown/Up` | 1×1 | 4 |
| `AB2_StairsDown/Up` | 2×2 | 8 |
| `AB2_GrandStairsDown/Up` | 3×3 | 12 |

Transit is a **teleport** (`Carry`) — "grand" buys approaches, not speed. All inherit `AB2_LinkBase`, which overrides `blueprintClass` to `Blueprint_Build`; **without it every link renders as a generic door while placing.** `ArriveRadius = LandingRadius + 1`, tied deliberately.

**Latent hole in `Carry`:** if a pawn lands exactly on `realDest.Cell`, neither the `StartPath` nor the `EndCurrentJob` branch runs — the pather was just cleared by `Notify_Teleported` and the job is left live. Not the observed stall (that needs `moving=true`), but unfixed.

---

# 12. PUBLISHING STATE

**`PublishedFileId.txt` is present** = **`3773267907`** (V1's was `3767572810`). **This is already a live Workshop item**, so `About.xml`'s `<description>` — still V1's — is a **live store page making false claims**: elevators, vertical conduit/water/duct/chem shafts, psycast cross-level targeting, caravans, Hospitality guest tours, trader airships, "zero recurring cost until you build a level". User-owned text; rewrite offered, not accepted.

Also stale: `About/known-issues.json` (V1's, 18 entries) · `ARCHITECTURE.md` · `docs/HELICOPTER_VIEW.md` · `docs/V2-HANDOFF.md`.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true` always. Companions: **`astryl.Circinus`** (formerly Modern Dev Suite — renamed; the old `astryl.moderndevsuite` id no longer resolves) + **`astryl.ModernDevTools`**, plus **`BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns`** + **`BiomesTeam.CoreFramework`** for cavern work. Palette pins get culled for Playing-gated debug actions — use the Debug Actions menu. **Banding happens at generation ⇒ needs a NEW colony.** Map gen ~3× slower. **Use inland tiles until transplant lands.** Transit logging and the watchdog reset every launch.
